tagline: Enterprise Construction Company, Fleet & Equipment Operations Platform

posts.title: Construction Project Tracking & Real-Time Jobsite Telemetry
posts.caption: Keep every jobsite on schedule and under budget. AppuTrak 1.0 delivers real-time project tracking, crew allocation, and site progress monitoring right from your mobile device.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Commercial construction jobsite active with mobile dashboard overlay displaying progress telemetry.

posts.title: Heavy Equipment & Fleet QR Code Tracking
posts.objective: Showcase QR code tag scanning for machinery and fleet assets.
posts.caption: Never lose track of high-value tools or machinery again. Scan QR code tags on equipment with AppuTrak 1.0 to view instant service logs, location, and operator assignments.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Technician scanning a durable QR code badge on an excavator with a rugged smartphone interface.

posts.title: Geofenced Jobsite Clock-In & Automated Time Logs
posts.objective: Promote automatic geofenced labor hour logging.
posts.caption: Eliminate manual timesheet errors. AppuTrak 1.0 automatically logs crew arrival and departure as soon as workers cross the jobsite geofence perimeter.

visual_spec.topic_visual: GPS satellite map showing a glowing green geofence boundary around a commercial build site with automatic clock-in popups.

posts.title: AIA Progress Billing (G702/G703) & Retainage
posts.objective: Demonstrate automated AIA schedule of values and billing.
posts.caption: Generate AIA G702 and G703 progress billing in minutes, not hours. AppuTrak 1.0 calculates completed work percentages, stored materials, and retainage automatically.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Formal AIA G702/G703 document preview rendered on a tablet with automated calculations highlight.

posts.title: Change Order Approval Workflows
posts.objective: Promote fast digital change order creation and client sign-off.
posts.caption: Unapproved changes bleed profits. Capture field change requests, attach photos, and get instant digital client sign-off on change orders with AppuTrak 1.0.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Digital change order authorization form on tablet screen with e-signature line highlighted in green.

posts.title: Lien Waiver Management & Partial Releases
posts.objective: Showcase automated partial and final lien release generation.
posts.caption: Protect your company from legal disputes. AppuTrak 1.0 generates conditional and unconditional lien waivers tied directly to invoice pay applications.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Legal seal icon alongside digital lien waiver release document with verification checkmarks.

posts.title: Multi-Company Contractor Portal
posts.objective: Highlight seamless multi-company switching and management.
posts.caption: Managing multiple sub-entities or regional branches? Switch companies with one tap in AppuTrak 1.0 while maintaining isolated financial records and crew permissions.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Company selector dropdown interface showing distinct general contractor company profiles.

posts.title: Geofenced Receipt & Expense Scanner
posts.objective: Promote receipt OCR scanning tied to specific jobsite budgets.
posts.caption: Snap a photo of supply store receipts on the road. AppuTrak 1.0's AI scanner automatically extracts vendor, totals, and categorizes expenses to the active jobsite.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Smartphone camera scanning a hardware store receipt with bounding box text extraction.

posts.title: Machinery Service History & Maintenance Logs
posts.objective: Highlight preventive maintenance logging for heavy machinery.
posts.caption: Prevent costly jobsite equipment breakdowns. Log engine hours, oil changes, and inspection notes in AppuTrak 1.0 to keep your entire fleet operating at peak performance.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Mechanic performing inspection on bulldozer with tablet showing service checklist.

posts.title: Construction Cost-to-Complete Analytics
posts.objective: Demonstrate real-time margin visibility and financial reporting.
posts.caption: Know your true job profitability before the project ends. AppuTrak 1.0 compares estimated vs. actual labor, materials, and equipment costs in real time.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Financial chart showing estimated budget bars vs actual cost bars with positive green profit margin callout.
